normalization.recenter: each hand centered on its own wrist (landmark 0)
normalization.scale: each hand scaled by distance wrist→middle-finger-MCP (landmark 9)
normalization.aspectCorrection: x pre-multiplied by source aspect ratio (w/h)
normalization.blendshapes: MediaPipe FaceLandmarker's 52 categorical blendshapes in canonical index order (0 = _neutral, then mouthSmile, browInnerUp, jawOpen, etc.). Raw [0, 1] scores, no normalization. Absent face → 52 zeros.
normalization.notes: Hands + face blendshapes only. Face landmark positions themselves are NOT in the vector — the 52 semantic shape coefficients carry expression signal at 1/9th the dims.

language.note: ASL-only project as of 2026-07-26. Feature vector is language-agnostic; models are per-language.

changeRule: If normalize.ts or the vector layout changes, bump version and update ml/import_media.py to match.

changelog.0.4: Added 52 face blendshapes for non-manual signals (NMS) — targets breaking the word-sign 72.7% ceiling. Hands block unchanged from v0.3.
changelog.0.3: Hands-only (126 dims) with per-hand wrist-anchored normalization — usable with hand-close-up datasets and language-agnostic.
changelog.0.2: Aspect-ratio pre-multiply on x — cross-camera-geometry invariance.
changelog.0.1: Initial spec: pose + 2 hands (225 dims), shoulder-centered + shoulder-scaled.
